rebuttals.argument: This sounds about right. After a couple of months, you figure out what works. Those of us who got burned by the Starbucks app a few times have found other places that are just as good, and we're sticking with them for now. The folks who actually go inside seem happier, which is great for them. And for those of us just trying to get to work on time, we're still checking our phones every morning to see who's going to be fastest. The new routines described in the ruling reflect how we've all adjusted.
